jobTitles.title: Job titles / keywords
jobTitles.description: One search per title. Boolean operators work (e.g. "python AND django").

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Every title is searched in every location. Use "Worldwide" for no location filter.

searchUrls.title: LinkedIn search URLs (optional)
searchUrls.description: Paste linkedin.com/jobs/search URLs directly. Their own filters are kept. Runs in addition to titles × locations.

maxResultsPerSearch.title: Max jobs per search
maxResultsPerSearch.description: Limit per title × location combination. LinkedIn exposes up to ~1,000 per search.

maxResultsTotal.title: Max jobs in total
maxResultsTotal.description: Hard cap for the whole run (0 = no cap). Controls your cost.

under10Applicants.title: Fewer than 10 applicants
under10Applicants.description: Only jobs with fewer than 10 applicants (early-bird jobs).

companyIds.title: Company IDs (optional)
companyIds.description: Restrict to LinkedIn numeric company IDs (e.g. 1441 for Google).

distanceMiles.title: Distance from location (miles)
distanceMiles.description: Radius around each location. Leave empty for LinkedIn default.

scrapeJobDetails.title: Scrape full job details
scrapeJobDetails.description: Full description, salary, seniority, industries, applicants, decoded apply URL, recruiter. Turn off for a fast, cheap listing-only run.

excludeCompanies.title: Exclude companies
excludeCompanies.description: Case-insensitive company names to skip (e.g. recruiting agencies).

maxRequestsPerMinute.title: Max requests per minute
maxRequestsPerMinute.description: Throttle to stay under LinkedIn rate limits. Raise with residential proxies.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies give the most reliable results on LinkedIn.
